title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2023
part_text: ‘notes with concern the ECA’s observation that lobbyists can choose to which category they belong, regardless of their legal form, to avoid disclosing financial information; notes that the EU is one of the largest global funders of civil society organisations; underlines the need for the EU Transparency Register Secretariat to enhance its systematic checks of the self-declarations of entities declaring themselves to be “NGOs, platforms, networks and similar”; observes that such systematic checks could be based on a set of criteria, including non-profit status, objectives relating to public benefit, and independence, to strengthen the trust in all entities registered in the EU Transparency Register, and should be supported by robust requirements for accountability and transparency;’ without the words: ‘declaring themselves to be “NGOs, platforms, networks and similar”; observes that such systematic checks could be based on a set of criteria, including non-profit status, objectives relating to public benefit, and independence,’
